newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn feedlot cattle market steady - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn feedlot cattle market steady - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were steady in a light test, compared with Tuesday's close, USDA said. Trade was moderate and demand mostly moderate. Seller interest light early, later moderate. Offerings light. Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1175-1250 lbs few 66.00 Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1050-1100 lbs 2 ld 65.00
Carcass Basis (weight only) Compared Tuesdays close -
Slaughter steers and heifers steady to firm.

( grade and weight) Choice 2-3 1250-1450 lbs no sales Select
